description: Return the published 2026 federal general election date and congressional primary/runoff schedule, optionally filtered to a state's public election jurisdiction. Source dates and tentative/changeable status are included. Does not include every local election, registration deadline or polling location; confirm actionable dates with the state's election authority.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code of the public records being researched, not the user's location.

name: get_election_calendar
title: Read sourced federal election dates
